<!--
This repo is designed to be forked and personalised, not contributed to directly.
Pull requests are welcome for documentation fixes, example script bugs, or new
generic patterns that anyone could reuse. Personal customisations belong in
your fork.
-->

## What this PR changes

One or two lines.

## Why

What problem does this solve, or what does it improve?

## Type of change

Pick one and delete the rest:

- Documentation fix
- Bug fix in an example script or template
- New generic pattern, prompt, ADR, or skill
- Other

## Checks

- [ ] No personal information added (names, emails, phone numbers, organisation names, file paths, exact figures)
- [ ] Voice rules followed (short sentences, no em dashes, no marketing words)
- [ ] If a template was changed, placeholders are still documented
- [ ] If an example script was changed, it still runs cleanly with sample data
